summary: Toronto Parking Authority operates an extensive inventory of over 304 off-street parking facilities containing over 40,000 spaces. 144 of these locations, including more than 24,000 parking spaces are managed and operated by Toronto Parking Authority under arrangements collectively described as "Parking Management Agreements" or "PMAs". Through Parking Management Agreements, Toronto Parking Authority provides some or all of the following parking management services: undertaking of capital improvements, provision of payment equipment, coin collection services, enforcement and maintenance. In most cases, Toronto Parking Authority provides a full range of services, however, a more limited arrangement may be provided in some cases at the request of the contracting party. In 2019, Toronto Parking Authority's parking management business generated approximately $31,524,683 in annual gross revenue. While demands and revenues have softened during the COVID-19 pandemic, it is expected that this part of Toronto Parking Authority’s business will thrive as public health restrictions are lifted. Directed that Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (July 5, 2021) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains positions, plans, procedures, criteria or instructions to be applied to any negotiations to be carried on by the Toronto Parking Authority.
